scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name auxilium-forst
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && cp -r dist /tmp/kunde-deploy-$$ && cp wrangler.kunde.jsonc /tmp/kunde-deploy-$$/wrangler.jsonc && CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=$CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN_KUNDE CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID_KUNDE wrangler pages deploy /tmp/kunde-deploy-$$/dist --project-name auxilium-forst-de-webseite && rm -rf /tmp/kunde-deploy-$$
scripts.db:production:migrations: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=$CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN_KUNDE CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID_KUNDE wrangler d1 migrations apply auxilium-production --remote --config wrangler.production.jsonc
